verdict.rationale: LegalZoom documents a dedicated annual report filing service, starting at $99. It covers prepared, personalized annual report filing, initial report filing, auto-filing of annual reports, optional expedited filing, and correction of filings rejected due to its own error. That is a managed service delivered directly by the provider. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the annual report service, and clarity on the conditions behind the † qualifier on auto-filing.

support.subject: As a founder, I can have the provider prepare and file my annual reports as a managed service or add-on

citations.quote: Hassle-free filing of your personalized annual report to satisfy your state filing requirement

Most businesses are legally required to file ongoing reports. File yours today with a plan that also offers end-to-end compliance coverage and support to help keep you in good standing.
